sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression detected by chemiluminescence in Xenopus oocytes; the HA-tagged construct served as the reference for quantifying surface levels of multiple Kv7.2 variants. Electrophysiological function of the tagged channel was not explicitly reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: L3, L4, and L5 all explicitly state that the HA tag is located in the extracellular S1-S2 loop of full-length, membrane-anchored Kv7.2 expressed in Xenopus oocytes, and that surface expression was successfully measured by chemiluminescence. The topology landmarks place EC1 at residues 114-127 (14 aa); the central portion (positions 116-125, sequence KEYEKSSEGA) is ≥3 residues from both TM1 (ends at 113) and TM2 (starts at 128), satisfying the TM-distance constraint. No specific junction residue is named in any of the three clips, so insert_after_residue is left null and the site is reported at loop resolution. The loop length (14 aa) is sufficient to accommodate a short epitope tag. Full-length Kv7.2 (KCNQ2) expressed in Xenopus oocytes with an HA epitope tag inserted in the extracellular S1-S2 loop (EC1, residues 114-127 by topology landmarks). Surface expression was quantified by whole-oocyte chemiluminescence assay across multiple C-terminal deletion constructs.

sources.claim: A systematic evaluation of Kv7.2 C-terminal deletion constructs in Xenopus oocytes revealed a remarkable effect of the linker between helices A and B on surface expression ( Fig. 1A ), which could be measured using an extracellular HA epitope tag located between S1–S2 [10] , [11] .

literature_notes: L1 (EGFP-Kv7.2-HA): Both the N-terminal EGFP and C-terminal HA are on the intracellular face — the KCNQ2 N-terminus (residues 1-92) and C-terminus (residues 312-872) are both intracellular per topology landmarks. Placed in other_positions. L2 (mCFP N-terminal): intracellular N-terminus, same reasoning. L6/L7 (5xMyc N-terminal): intracellular; L7 confirms function preserved but the tag is not on the extracellular face. Placed in other_positions. L8/L9 (FLAG knockin): The clips provide only the CRISPR guide RNA sequence (DNA), not the protein position of the FLAG insertion; the protein junction cannot be pinned from the ledger text, so no site can be proposed. L10-L14 (Halo-TAC-KCNQ2): The HaloTag is displayed extracellularly via a heterologous TAC single-pass TM domain fused upstream of KCNQ2 — it is not inserted into any extracellular loop or terminus of KCNQ2 itself. The KCNQ2 N-terminus remains intracellular. This construct does not constitute a tag on KCNQ2's own extracellular surface and does not qualify. L15/L16 (C-terminal 3xFLAG): intracellular C-terminus. Placed in other_positions. The S3-S4 loop (EC2, residues 186-190, only 5 aa) and the pore loop (EC3, residues 253-292) have no ledger support for any tag insertion and are not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal 5xMyc tag on full-length Kv7.2 expressed in Xenopus oocytes; electrophysiological properties indistinguishable from untagged (L7), but the N-terminus (residues 1-92) is intracellular and not a surface tag site.
C-terminal 3xFLAG tag on mKcnq2; the C-terminus (residues 312-872) is intracellular and not a surface tag site.
